documents.title: Single-allele nanoscale mapping of regulatory variants.
meta: Hamley, Joseph C; Zhang, Weijiao; Willmott, Daniel; Chen, Lucia Y; Sharlandjieva, Vassilena; Li, Hangpeng; Dalgleish, James L T; Denny, Nicholas; Agarwal, Gaurav; Hentges, Lance; Ozcan, Bora; Doll, Roman M; Wei, Ye; Riva, Simone G; Venkatesh, Samvida S; Arachi, Marta; Agarwal, Devika; Akkuratov, Evgeny E; Baxter, Matthew; Sauka-Spengler, Tatjana; Dendrou, Calliope A; Milne, Thomas A; Hughes, Jim R; Davies, James O J
Nature genetics
documents.summary: 该文开发了单等位基因染色质结构分析平台MCCv，用于定位调控变异与靶基因，虽不直接研究cpcdh基因家族，但其变异-功能解析方法可借鉴于该家族调控机制研究。
documents.abstract: Millions of genetic variants are linked to human disease but identifying underlying mechanisms is challenging because most variants are noncausal and lie within the noncoding genome. We developed a Micro Capture-C variant-to-function platform (MCCv) based on analysis of single-allele chromatin structure. This can identify changes in nanoscale chromatin architecture and link variants in cis-regulatory elements to target genes. Furthermore, MCCv can phase other heterozygous variants within a locus to link regulatory variants to allelically imbalanced gene expression and directly read out variant effects on chromatin interactions after genome editing. With this approach, we investigated 405 cis-regulatory elements linked to immune-mediated inflammatory disease in CD4(+) T cells. We uncovered a previously undescribed gain-of-function mechanism, which increases risk of autoimmunity through creation of a neo-CTCF motif that blocks super-enhancer contacts with the SESN3 promoter. We showed that SESN3 regulates mammalian target of rapamycin by sensing tryptophan and demonstrated its role in autoimmunity using mouse models. 数百万遗传变异与人类疾病相关，但识别其潜在机制颇具挑战，因为大多数变异并非致病性，且位于非编码基因组中。我们开发了一种基于单等位基因染色质结构分析的微捕获C变体到功能平台（MCCv）。该平台能够识别纳米尺度染色质结构的变化，并将顺式调控元件中的变异与靶基因联系起来。此外，MCCv可以对基因座内的其他杂合变异进行定相，以将调控变异与等位基因不平衡的基因表达相关联，并在基因组编辑后直接读出变异对染色质相互作用的影响。利用此方法，我们研究了CD4(+) T细胞中与免疫介导的炎症性疾病相关的405个顺式调控元件。我们发现了一种先前未描述的功能获得机制，该机制通过创建一个新的CTCF基序来增加自身免疫风险，该基序阻断超增强子与SESN3启动子的接触。我们证明SESN3通过感知色氨酸来调节哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白，并利用小鼠模型展示了其在自身免疫中的作用。

documents.title: Aging-associated SATB1 deficiency remodels 3D genome architecture and transcriptional programs in naive CD4(+) T cells.
meta: Wang, Bao; Ji, Luzhang; Bian, Qian
Science advances
documents.summary: 该文研究衰老相关SATB1缺陷对CD4+ T细胞三维基因组和转录的影响，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: Precise three-dimensional (3D) genome organization is crucial for regulating gene expression during development, yet its role in age-related transcriptional changes and physiological decline remains elusive. Here, we show that aging reshapes chromatin architecture and gene regulation in murine naive CD4(+) T cells, a quiescent T cell population essential for adaptive immunity. Aged naive CD4(+) T cells exhibit intrinsic transcriptional reprogramming marked by increased expression of inflammatory and T cell activation-related genes, rendering them more prone to activation. Intriguingly, these changes are accompanied by pronounced alterations in 3D genome organization, including widespread weakening of topologically associating domain (TAD) boundaries and extensive enhancer-promoter rewiring. Mechanistically, we demonstrate that these age-associated structural changes can be partly attributed to the diminished expression of chromatin organizer SATB1. SATB1 colocalizes with CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF) in young naive T cells to spatially constrain CTCF-binding sites. Its decline with age extends the range of CTCF-mediated interactions without altering CTCF occupancy, leading to remodeling of chromatin architecture and up-regulation of proinflammatory and proactivation genes. Conditional SATB1 deletion in naive T cells recapitulates the 3D genome and transcriptional changes observed in aging. Our findings reveal a critical role for SATB1 in maintaining 3D genome integrity in naive T cells and suggest that the dysregulation of genome architecture contributes to immune and organismal aging. 精确的三维（3D）基因组组织对于发育过程中基因表达的调控至关重要，但其在与年龄相关的转录变化和生理衰退中的作用仍不清楚。在此，我们表明衰老重塑了小鼠初始CD4(+) T细胞（一种对适应性免疫至关重要的静息T细胞群体）中的染色质结构和基因调控。衰老的初始CD4(+) T细胞表现出内在的转录重编程，其特征是炎症和T细胞激活相关基因表达增加，使其更易被激活。有趣的是，这些变化伴随着3D基因组组织的显著改变，包括拓扑关联结构域（TAD）边界的广泛减弱和增强子-启动子连接的广泛重连。机制上，我们证明这些与年龄相关的结构变化部分归因于染色质组织者SATB1表达的减少。SATB1在年轻初始T细胞中与CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）共定位，以空间上约束CTCF结合位点。其随年龄增长而减少，扩展了CTCF介导的相互作用范围，而不改变CTCF占据率，导致染色质结构重塑以及促炎和促激活基因的上调。初始T细胞中条件性SATB1缺失重现了衰老中观察到的3D基因组和转录变化。我们的发现揭示了SATB1在维持初始T细胞3D基因组完整性中的关键作用，并提示基因组结构失调有助于免疫和机体衰老。

documents.title: DNMT1-Mediated Epigenetic Reprogramming Drives KMT2A Amplifications and Rearrangements.
meta: Lineberger, Madison A; Gray, Zach H; Ferman, Benjamin I; O'Donnell, Erin; Smith, Rebecca G; Schiela, Kathleen; Udara, Anushka; Chetal, Kashish; Azadegan, Chloe; Toma, Monika Maria; Sumner, Ethan; Santoro, John; Miranda, Christopher; Ahmed, Manna; Wilson, Jade; Lautert-Dutra, William; Li, Chencheng; McKelvey, Aidan; Kaniskan, H Umit; Zhang, Wenyun; Jin, Jian; Puddu, Fabio; Consugar, Mark; Walsh, Martin; Bellacosa, Alfonso; Duy, Cihangir; Lee, Hayan; Skorski, Tomasz; Liu, Yu; Sadreyev, Ruslan I; Whetstine, Johnathan R
bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
documents.summary: 该文研究DNMT1介导的表观遗传重编程驱动KMT2A扩增和重排，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: MLL/KMT2A amplifications and rearrangements are prevalent in infant, adult, and therapy-induced leukemia; however, the molecular contributors controlling these alterations remain elusive. Here, we reveal that rapid CTCF degradation generates local genome structure alterations at KMT2A and copy gains and rearrangements. We then established a conserved, coordinated interplay between DNA and histone methylation pathways that control CTCF occupancy, and in turn, KMT2A locus stability. For example, DNMT1 overexpression promotes increased H3K9 methylation, reduced CTCF occupancy, and causes KMT2A alterations. However, DNMT1 inhibition suppresses these events and KMT2A alterations caused by topoisomerase II inhibition. Locus-specific epigenome targeting demonstrated that DNA or H3K9 methylation promotes KMT2A copy gains and rearrangement, whereas targeted TET activity suppresses these events upon methylation perturbation or doxorubicin treatment. These findings identify a conserved, coordinated DNA-histone methylation axis governing KMT2A amplifications and rearrangement susceptibility, revealing biomarkers and therapeutic targets to predict and intercept these events in cancer. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: This study reveals a conserved DNA-histone methylation mechanism controlling the susceptibility of the KMT2A locus to copy gain and rearrange. These events can be generated or prevented by genetic, therapeutic or epigenome editing. Furthermore, DNMT1 inhibition blocks chemotherapy-induced KMT2A disruption, identifying a therapeutic strategy to intercept these oncogenic genomic alterations. MLL/KMT2A扩增和重排常见于婴儿、成人及治疗诱导的白血病中；然而，控制这些改变的分子贡献者仍难以捉摸。在此，我们揭示快速CTCF降解在KMT2A位点产生局部基因组结构改变以及拷贝数增加和重排。随后，我们建立了DNA和组蛋白甲基化通路之间保守的协调相互作用，该作用控制CTCF占据，进而影响KMT2A位点稳定性。例如，DNMT1过表达促进H3K9甲基化增加、CTCF占据减少，并导致KMT2A改变。然而，DNMT1抑制可抑制这些事件以及由拓扑异构酶II抑制引起的KMT2A改变。位点特异性表观基因组靶向表明，DNA或H3K9甲基化促进KMT2A拷贝数增加和重排，而靶向TET活性在甲基化扰动或多柔比星处理下抑制这些事件。这些发现确定了一个保守的、协调的DNA-组蛋白甲基化轴，控制KMT2A扩增和重排易感性，揭示了预测和拦截癌症中这些事件的生物标志物和治疗靶点。意义声明：本研究揭示了一种保守的DNA-组蛋白甲基化机制，控制KMT2A位点对拷贝数增加和重排的易感性。这些事件可通过遗传、治疗或表观基因组编辑产生或预防。此外，DNMT1抑制阻断化疗诱导的KMT2A破坏，确定了一种拦截这些致癌基因组改变的治疗策略。

documents.title: Genetic mechanisms of mitotic error in 840,853 blood genomes.
meta: Si, Yichen; Kamitaki, Nolan; Tang, David; Loh, Po-Ru
medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
documents.summary: 该文研究血细胞嵌合非整倍体的遗传机制，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: Mosaic aneuploidies in leukocytes are commonly detectable in aging individuals. Here, we studied inherited genetic influences on susceptibility to such aneuploidies by precisely quantifying chromosomal ploidy from whole-genome sequencing read-depth in 840,853 individuals. This approach revealed autosomal gains in  approximately 70,000 individuals (7-fold more than previous data sets) and ubiquitous loss of the X chromosome in females and loss of Y in males, each of which exhibited > 50% heritability. Genome-wide association analyses of 12 mosaic aneuploidies identified > 800 common inherited influences on the generation and proliferation of aneuploid cells. Variants in mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint genes consistently affected aneuploidy of most chromosomes, whereas a missense variant in PMF1 (which encodes a subunit of the outer kinetochore) associated with increased segregation fidelity of some chromosomes at the expense of others. Structural variation within multiple chromosomes associated with allele-specific effects on missegregation rates. An inherited hybrid centromere formed by an ancient recombination of 22q with 13p-generating the largest common structural variant in the human genome-associated with 4-fold greater risk of chromosome 22 gain. Abundant copy number and sequence variation in two X-linked CTCF-binding repeat arrays, ICCE and DXZ4 , associated with a 4-fold range in the likelihoods of different X chromosomes to be lost. These results show how genetic risk of chromosomal gains and losses varies greatly across chromosomes and across people, providing instruments for assessing the effects of mosaic aneuploidies on health. 马赛克非整倍体在衰老个体的白细胞中普遍可检测到。本研究通过精确量化840,853个个体的全基因组测序读取深度中的染色体倍性，探讨了遗传因素对此类非整倍体易感性的影响。该方法在约70,000名个体中检测到常染色体获得（比以往数据集多7倍），并发现女性中X染色体普遍丢失，男性中Y染色体普遍丢失，每种情况均表现出超过50%的遗传力。对12种马赛克非整倍体的全基因组关联分析识别出超过800个常见的遗传影响，这些影响涉及非整倍体细胞的生成与增殖。有丝分裂纺锤体组装检查点基因的变异一致地影响大多数染色体的非整倍性，而PMF1（编码外着丝粒亚基）中的一个错义变异与某些染色体分离保真度增加相关，但以其他染色体为代价。多个染色体内的结构变异与等位基因特异性效应相关，影响错误分离率。一个由22q与13p古老重组形成的遗传杂合着丝粒——产生人类基因组中最大的常见结构变异——与染色体22获得风险增加4倍相关。两个X连锁CTCF结合重复阵列ICCE和DXZ4中的丰富拷贝数和序列变异，与不同X染色体丢失可能性的4倍范围相关。这些结果表明，染色体获得和丢失的遗传风险在不同染色体和不同个体间差异显著，为评估马赛克非整倍体对健康的影响提供了工具。

documents.title: Cohesin on the move: navigating genomic traffic during loop extrusion.
meta: Guo, Qiao; Yuen, Karen Wing Yee; Zhang, Haoyue
Current opinion in structural biology
documents.summary: 该文综述cohesin在环挤压中的机械调控机制，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: Cohesin is a central architect of the 3D genome. As it extrudes DNA, it must navigate a 'busy' genomic landscape, leading to constant biophysical engagements with diverse chromatin binding proteins and molecular machineries. In this review, we examine how cohesin's loop extrusion is shaped by mechanical encounters with directional barriers like CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF), moving transcriptional fronts, and advancing replication forks. We highlight how these players can arrest, slow, or actively push cohesin, dynamically modulating chromatin topology. Furthermore, we discuss how the replisome traverses the cohesin ring to establish cohesion and how repair factors leverage extrusion to facilitate homology searching. Finally, we delineate the crosstalk among structural maintenance of chromosomes (SMC) motors during mitotic entry. Collectively, our review provides a comprehensive framework for these multifaceted interactions and highlights key unresolved questions, offering a future perspective on the mechanical principles of cohesin governing genome organization. 黏连蛋白（cohesin）是三维基因组的核心建筑师。在挤出DNA的过程中，它必须穿越一个“繁忙”的基因组景观，导致与多种染色质结合蛋白和分子机器持续发生生物物理相互作用。在本综述中，我们探讨了黏连蛋白的环挤出如何受到与方向性屏障（如CCCTC结合因子（CTCF））、移动的转录前沿和前进的复制叉的机械性遭遇所塑造。我们重点阐述了这些因子如何能够阻止、减缓或主动推动黏连蛋白，动态调节染色质拓扑结构。此外，我们讨论了复制体（replisome）如何穿越黏连蛋白环以建立黏连，以及修复因子如何利用挤出过程促进同源搜索。最后，我们描述了有丝分裂进入期间染色体结构维持（SMC）马达之间的串扰。总体而言，我们的综述为这些多方面的相互作用提供了一个综合框架，并强调了关键未解问题，为黏连蛋白调控基因组组织的机械原理提供了未来展望。

documents.title: Lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide particles may impair cognitive function via CTCF-associated suppression of NMDAR-dependent synaptogenesis.
meta: Guan, Xinchao; Xie, Lijie; Li, Guoliang; He, Yujie; Chen, Shilin; Wang, Han; Yuan, Wenke; Gao, Huan; Chen, Ming; Yang, Xiaoge; Luo, Yingxia; Shao, Xiaojian; Chen, Wen; Liu, Lili; Wang, Qing
Journal of hazardous materials
documents.summary: 该文研究锂电池材料NCM的神经毒性机制，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: Lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide (NCM) is the predominant cathode material for lithium-ion batteries (LIBs); however, its occupational health risks remain insufficiently understood. In this study, we found that in occupationally NCM‑exposed workers, urinary levels of Li, Ni, Co, and Mn were negatively associated with Mini‑Cog test scores and positively associated with serum neurofilament light chain (NfL, as neuronal injury marker). In an intratracheal instillation rat model, NCM-exposed rats exhibited learning and memory deficits, neuronal injury, and reduced synaptic complexity. RNA‑seq analysis revealed suppression of N-methyl-D-aspartate receptors (NMDAR)‑dependent synaptogenesis pathways in rat hippocampus, along with downregulation of NMDAR subunits (GluN2A and GluN2B) and postsynaptic proteins such as CaMKII‑alpha, MAP2, PSD‑95, and Synapsin‑1. In SH-SY5Y cells, treatment with NCM-derived metals recapitulated these gene expression changes. Bioinformatics analysis identified CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF) as a potential regulator of NMDAR. Cellular thermal shift assays (CETSA) identified the binding of NCM-derived metals to CTCF. Based on in vivo data, human equivalent concentrations (HECs) derived from BMDL(10) of Ni and Mn were below the current OELs of China and America. Collectively, these findings indicate that NCM may induce neurotoxicity and impair learning and memory by disrupting synaptogenesis, and CTCF is implicated in this process. 锂镍钴锰氧化物（NCM）是锂离子电池（LIBs）的主要正极材料；然而，其职业健康风险仍未得到充分认识。在本研究中，我们发现，在职业性NCM暴露工人中，尿液中Li、Ni、Co和Mn水平与Mini-Cog测试得分呈负相关，并与血清神经丝轻链（NfL，作为神经元损伤标志物）呈正相关。在气管内滴注大鼠模型中，NCM暴露大鼠表现出学习记忆缺陷、神经元损伤和突触复杂性降低。RNA-seq分析揭示了大鼠海马中N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体（NMDAR）依赖性突触发生通路受到抑制，同时NMDAR亚基（GluN2A和GluN2B）及突触后蛋白如CaMKII-α、MAP2、PSD-95和Synapsin-1下调。在SH-SY5Y细胞中，用NCM衍生金属处理重现了这些基因表达变化。生物信息学分析将CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）确定为NMDAR的潜在调控因子。细胞热位移分析（CETSA）确定了NCM衍生金属与CTCF的结合。基于体内数据，由Ni和Mn的BMDL(10)推导的人等效浓度（HECs）低于中国和美国当前的职业接触限值（OELs）。综合来看，这些发现表明NCM可能通过破坏突触发生诱导神经毒性并损害学习记忆，且CTCF参与此过程。

documents.title: CDX2 Drives Divergent Regional Programs During Intestinal Development and Redeploys Them During Regeneration
meta: Lorzadeh A; Ye G; Romero-Wolf M; Quiloan ML; Sharma S; Sanchez E; Jadhav U
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文研究CDX2转录因子在肠道发育和再生中的区域特异性调控，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: Region-specific transcription factors (TFs) establish small intestinal and colonic identity, yet what activates their region-specific expression during development is unresolved. Moreover, discrete fetal gene sets reactivate during post-injury regeneration, but their full scope, and what reactivates the programs required to restore regional identity and tissue structure, remain unclear. By determining CDX2 and partner TF binding, enhancer activity, and gene expression dynamics across intestinal regions, in stem and differentiating cells, and through development and adult regeneration, here we show that CDX2, despite uniform expression across the fetal and adult intestinal epithelium, organizes a hierarchical enhancer network. This network cooperates with partner factors such as CTCF to establish a shared, plastic fetal enhancer landscape, which resolves into region-specific programs upstream of regional TFs. During regeneration, rather than reactivating a general fetal state, CDX2 selectively rebinds many region-specific and common enhancers for genes associated with fetal cell-motility and tissue-morphogenesis signatures along with a more recently active adult stem-cell program, each deployed across distinct crypt tiers. CDX2 thus functions as a central, context-responsive regulator, deploying fetal, adult stem-cell differentiation, and regenerative programs as tissue context requires. 区域特异性转录因子（TFs）建立小肠和结肠的身份特征，但它们在发育过程中激活区域特异性表达的机制尚不明确。此外，离散的胎儿基因集在损伤后再生期间重新激活，但其全部范围以及重新激活恢复区域身份和组织结构所需程序的因素仍不清楚。通过测定CDX2及伙伴转录因子的结合、增强子活性以及跨肠道区域、干细胞和分化细胞中、以及发育和成体再生过程中的基因表达动态，我们在此表明，CDX2尽管在胎儿和成体肠上皮中均匀表达，却组织了一个层级增强子网络。该网络与CTCF等伙伴因子协作，建立一个共享的、可塑的胎儿增强子景观，该景观在区域转录因子上游解析为区域特异性程序。在再生过程中，CDX2并非重新激活一般性胎儿状态，而是选择性地重新结合许多区域特异性和常见增强子，这些增强子与胎儿细胞运动和組織形态发生特征相关的基因，以及一个更近期活跃的成体干细胞程序相关联，每个程序在不同隐窝层级中部署。因此，CDX2作为一个中心性的、情境响应的调节因子，根据组织情境需求部署胎儿、成体干细胞分化和再生程序。

documents.title: Placental DNA Methylation of HSD11B2 and IGF2 Is Associated With Fetal Growth in the Cebu Longitudinal Health and Nutrition Survey.
meta: Klibaner-Schiff, Eleanor; Rutherford, Julienne; deMartelly, Victoria; Lagardo, Fe; Gundling, William; Wildman, Derek E; Lee, Nanette R; Kuzawa, Christopher
American journal of human biology : the official journal of the Human Biology Council
documents.summary: 该文研究胎盘HSD11B2和IGF2的DNA甲基化与胎儿生长的关联，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: OBJECTIVES: The intrauterine environment exerts lasting impacts on fetal growth and development, with potential long-term effects on later health. We examined whether placental DNA methylation at HSD11B2 and IGF2-two key regulators of the intrauterine environment-is associated with fetal growth among participants in the Cebu Longitudinal Health and Nutrition Survey (CLHNS). METHODS: We analyzed DNA methylation in placental samples from 19 births in the CLHNS using the Illumina Infinium HumanMethylation450 BeadChip. Focusing on CpG sites within HSD11B2 and the IGF2/H19 imprinting control region (ICR), we used linear regression models adjusted for gestational age to assess associations of DNA methylation with birth weight, head circumference, length, and neonatal adiposity. RESULTS: Higher methylation at three CpG sites within HSD11B2 was significantly associated with reduced fetal growth: one site was associated with reduced birth weight and head circumference, and two sites were associated with shorter birth length. Within the IGF2/H19 ICR, two CpG sites were significantly associated with both increased birth weight and head circumference. Both CpGs overlapped with predicted CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF) binding sites, consistent with known regulatory mechanisms linking increased methylation at the ICR to increased IGF2 expression. CONCLUSIONS: These findings support the hypothesis that DNA methylation at regulatory regions of HSD11B2 and IGF2 contributes to variation in fetal growth, linking placental epigenetic patterns to birth outcomes. 目的：宫内环境对胎儿生长发育具有持久影响，并可能对后期健康产生长期效应。我们考察了参与宿务纵向健康与营养调查（CLHNS）的个体中，胎盘HSD11B2和IGF2（这两个是宫内环境的关键调节因子）的DNA甲基化是否与胎儿生长相关。方法：我们使用Illumina Infinium HumanMethylation450 BeadChip分析了CLHNS中19例出生个体的胎盘样本DNA甲基化。聚焦于HSD11B2和IGF2/H19印记控制区（ICR）内的CpG位点，我们使用调整了孕周的线性回归模型来评估DNA甲基化与出生体重、头围、身长和新生儿肥胖度的关联。结果：HSD11B2内三个CpG位点的较高甲基化与胎儿生长减少显著相关：一个位点与出生体重和头围减少相关，两个位点与出生身长较短相关。在IGF2/H19 ICR内，两个CpG位点与出生体重和头围增加均显著相关。这两个CpG位点均与预测的CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）结合位点重叠，这与已知的调控机制一致，即ICR甲基化增加与IGF2表达增加相关。结论：这些发现支持了HSD11B2和IGF2调控区域DNA甲基化有助于胎儿生长变异的假说，将胎盘表观遗传模式与出生结局联系起来。

documents.title: Ctcf deficiency in myofibers induces pathological genome reprogramming toward the spontaneous development of myopathy
meta: Massenet J; Nicoletti C; Caputo L; Hüttner SS; Nicolau M; Barajas JR; Rossi M; Yang Y; Ancel S; Wang YX; Malfatti E; Cheung TH; Witcher M; Crist C; Puri PL
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 该文研究肌纤维中Ctcf缺失导致3D基因组重编程和肌病发生，虽非直接研究cpcdh基因家族，但其基因组调控和肌病机制可为cpcdh家族功能研究提供借鉴。
documents.abstract: How perennial, postmitotic multinucleated tissues, such as skeletal myofibers, maintain their identity and transcriptional adaptation to homeostatic perturbations through adult life is an outstanding question. To address this issue, we investigated the consequences of loss of 3D-genome architecture in skeletal muscles by generating myofiber-specific Ctcf- deficient ( Ctcf mKO ) mice. Ctcf mKO mice did not exhibit muscular phenotype at birth but spontaneously developed a severe myopathy. Integrated analysis of snRNAseq, ATACseq and promoter-capture Hi-C revealed both common and fiber-type specific patterns of dysregulated gene expression associated with alterations in chromatin accessibility and promoter-based interactions in Ctcf-deficient myonuclei at distinct stages of myopathy development. Decreased chromatin accessibility at promoters and changes in their connectivity with distal elements were observed across all myonuclei as a direct consequence of Ctcf deficiency at early stages and associated with downregulation of genes implicated in myofiber contraction and anabolism, metabolism, adhesion and neuromuscular transmission. Conversely, at later stages, upregulation of genes leading to persistent activation of ER stress/UPR and catabolism resulted from global reconfiguration of chromatin structure and connectivity, partly as indirect consequence of Ctcf deficiency. Notably, type-IIB myonuclei exhibited specific alterations in gene expression that culminated in loss of fiber-type identity and ectopic expression of inflammatory genes. These results reveal a requirement of Ctcf for maintenance of fiber-type identity and transcriptional adaptation in vivo , through multilayered control of 3D genome integrity. They also indicate an unprecedented association between Ctcf deficiency in myofibers and susceptibility to develop myopathies, whereby Ctcf dispensability for developmental myogenesis confers vulnerability to develop myopathic syndromes. 多年生、有丝分裂后多核组织（如骨骼肌纤维）如何在成年生活中维持其身份及对稳态扰动的转录适应，是一个悬而未决的问题。为解决此问题，我们通过生成肌纤维特异性Ctcf缺陷（Ctcf mKO）小鼠，研究了骨骼肌中3D基因组结构丧失的后果。Ctcf mKO小鼠出生时未表现出肌肉表型，但自发发展为严重肌病。对snRNAseq、ATACseq和启动子捕获Hi-C的综合分析揭示了在肌病发展的不同阶段，Ctcf缺陷肌核中与染色质可及性和基于启动子的相互作用改变相关的基因表达失调的常见及纤维类型特异性模式。在早期阶段，所有肌核中观察到启动子处染色质可及性降低及其与远端元件连接性的变化，这是Ctcf缺陷的直接后果，并与涉及肌纤维收缩和合成代谢、代谢、粘附及神经肌肉传递的基因下调相关。相反，在后期阶段，导致内质网应激/UPR和分解代谢持续激活的基因上调，源于染色质结构和连接性的全局重构，部分作为Ctcf缺陷的间接后果。值得注意的是，IIB型肌核表现出特定的基因表达改变，最终导致纤维类型身份丧失和炎症基因异位表达。这些结果揭示了Ctcf在体内通过多层控制3D基因组完整性，对维持纤维类型身份和转录适应的必要性。它们还表明，肌纤维中Ctcf缺陷与肌病易感性之间存在前所未有的关联，其中Ctcf在发育性肌生成中的非必需性赋予了个体发展肌病综合征的脆弱性。

documents.title: CTCF-FXN regulatory axis plays critical roles in clinical assessments and disease progression of primary open-angle glaucoma.
meta: Cai, Danrui; Yu, Yao; Ma, Junze; Li, Ting; Liu, Ziyao
Journal of molecular medicine (Berlin, Germany)
documents.summary: 该文研究CTCF-FXN调控轴在青光眼中的作用，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: Primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) is an irreversible ophthalmic disease that is the leading cause of blindness. Oxidative stress (OS) is considered an important contributor to POAG pathogenesis. However, its mechanism of action in POAG remains vague. FXN was identified as a candidate OS-related gene associated with POAG through WGCNA and two machine learning methods (LASSO regression and SVM-RFE). Through multiple bioinformatic analyses, FXN exhibited potential diagnostic value and was associated with immune-related signatures in POAG samples. GSEA revealed that high FXN expression was associated with enrichment of glycolysis- and pyruvate metabolism-related gene sets. FXN expression was significantly decreased in an H2O2 in vitro model (R28 cells). CCK8, EdU, TUNEL, ROS detection and flow cytometry assays indicated that FXN overexpression improved retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) viability and inhibited cell apoptosis and ROS accumulation. Mechanistically, CTCF was demonstrated to transcriptionally regulate FXN by binding to its promoter region, as confirmed by ChIP assay. FXN deletion partially abolished the protective effects of CTCF overexpression on RGC viability, apoptosis, and oxidative stress responses. In conclusions, FXN may represent a potential biomarker associated with POAG. The identification of the CTCF-FXN regulatory axis provides new insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying POAG. 原发性开角型青光眼（POAG）是一种不可逆的眼科疾病，是导致失明的主要原因。氧化应激（OS）被认为是POAG发病机制中的重要因素。然而，其在POAG中的作用机制仍不明确。通过WGCNA和两种机器学习方法（LASSO回归和SVM-RFE），FXN被鉴定为与POAG相关的候选OS相关基因。通过多种生物信息学分析，FXN在POAG样本中表现出潜在的诊断价值，并与免疫相关特征相关联。GSEA显示，FXN高表达与糖酵解和丙酮酸代谢相关基因集的富集有关。在H2O2体外模型（R28细胞）中，FXN表达显著降低。CCK8、EdU、TUNEL、ROS检测和流式细胞术分析表明，FXN过表达提高了视网膜神经节细胞（RGCs）的活力，并抑制了细胞凋亡和ROS积累。机制上，ChIP实验证实CTCF通过结合其启动子区域对FXN进行转录调控。FXN缺失部分消除了CTCF过表达对RGC活力、凋亡和氧化应激反应的保护作用。总之，FXN可能代表与POAG相关的潜在生物标志物。CTCF-FXN调控轴的鉴定为POAG的分子机制提供了新的见解。

documents.title: Methyl-donor inhibitors relax 3D genome structures to promote totipotent reprogramming.
meta: Yang, Tianchang; Li, Lincheng; Zhao, Jingru; Cheng, Ruoqi; Qi, Yueyao; Bu, Yifan; Chen, Hebing; Shi, Minglei; Xu, Jun; Deng, Hongkui; Li, Cheng
Cell reports
documents.summary: 该文研究甲基供体代谢抑制对3D基因组结构重塑及全能性重编程的影响，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联，但涉及表观遗传和基因组结构调控，可借鉴其机制研究思路。
documents.abstract: The 3D genome safeguards cell identity while shaping developmental plasticity, yet its coordination with metabolism during cell fate transitions remains unclear. Here, we use a mouse totipotent stem cell induction system to dissect the role of methyl-donor metabolism in 3D genome remodeling and cell fate transitions. We show that inhibition of methyl-donor pathways enhances reprogramming toward a totipotent-like state and drives widespread relaxation of 3D genome architecture, characterized by reduced chromatin compaction and attenuated higher-order chromatin organization. Mechanistically, methyl-donor inhibitors induce pronounced DNA hypomethylation and modest reductions in histone methylation, accompanied by decreased chromatin binding of DNA methylation-associated chromatin regulators, with limited effects at CTCF-enriched regions, suggesting that methyl-donor inhibition enhances reprogramming by disrupting pre-existing 3D genome organization through largely CTCF-independent mechanisms. Together, our findings reveal metabolic-3D genome cooperation as a mechanism for lowering the barrier to totipotency and point to regenerative targets beyond canonical chromatin architectural proteins. 3D基因组在维护细胞身份的同时塑造发育可塑性，但其在细胞命运转变过程中与代谢的协调机制仍不清楚。在此，我们利用小鼠全能干细胞诱导系统，解析甲基供体代谢在3D基因组重塑和细胞命运转变中的作用。我们表明，抑制甲基供体途径可增强向全能样状态的重编程，并驱动3D基因组结构的广泛松弛，其特征为染色质压缩减少和高阶染色质组织减弱。机制上，甲基供体抑制剂诱导显著的DNA低甲基化和组蛋白甲基化的适度降低，伴随DNA甲基化相关染色质调节因子在染色质上的结合减少，而对CTCF富集区域的影响有限，提示甲基供体抑制通过主要不依赖CTCF的机制破坏预先存在的3D基因组组织，从而增强重编程。综上，我们的发现揭示了代谢-3D基因组协作作为降低全能性屏障的机制，并指向超越经典染色质结构蛋白的再生靶点。

documents.title: GSLR Drives Lung Adenocarcinoma as a Critical Regulator of Energy Homeostasis Through Creatine Kinase B Activation.
meta: Qian, Xinyi; Yang, Juze; Ren, Jiayi; Mao, Xiaowei; Li, Jia; Sun, Tengfei; Dong, Liangliang; Chen, Enguo; Lu, Yan; Liu, Pengyuan
Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)
documents.summary: 该文研究lncRNA GSLR通过CKB调控肺癌能量代谢，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality, with extremely high energy demands during progression. Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) have emerged as crucial regulators in cancer metabolism; however, their role in reprogramming energy metabolism in lung cancer remains incompletely understood. In this study, we identify a glucose/glutamine sensitive lncRNA, GSLR, as a driver of lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) progression. GSLR is markedly upregulated in LUAD, and its high expression is associated with poor patient prognosis. Nutrient restriction reduces chromatin accessibility at the GSLR locus via altered histone marks, whereas CTCF activates its transcription. Mechanistically, GSLR directly binds the RNA helicase DHX9 and recruits it to the creatine kinase B (CKB) promoter, arresting R-loop accumulation and thereby promoting CKB transcription. Elevated CKB expression sustains intracellular ATP homeostasis, thereby stabilizing mitochondrial membrane potential, preventing calcium overload, and reducing reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation. Collectively, our findings identify GSLR as a novel regulator of energy homeostasis that promotes lung cancer progression through the GSLR/DHX9/CKB axis. Targeting GSLR may thus represent a promising therapeutic strategy for LUAD. 肺癌仍然是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，其进展过程中具有极高的能量需求。长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）已成为癌症代谢中的关键调控因子；然而，它们在肺癌能量代谢重编程中的作用仍未被完全理解。在本研究中，我们鉴定了一个葡萄糖/谷氨酰胺敏感的lncRNA，GSLR，作为肺腺癌（LUAD）进展的驱动因子。GSLR在LUAD中显著上调，其高表达与患者不良预后相关。营养限制通过改变组蛋白标记降低GSLR位点的染色质可及性，而CTCF则激活其转录。机制上，GSLR直接结合RNA解旋酶DHX9，并将其招募至肌酸激酶B（CKB）启动子，阻止R-loop积累，从而促进CKB转录。CKB表达升高维持细胞内ATP稳态，进而稳定线粒体膜电位，防止钙超载，并减少活性氧（ROS）积累。总体而言，我们的发现将GSLR鉴定为能量稳态的新型调控因子，通过GSLR/DHX9/CKB轴促进肺癌进展。因此，靶向GSLR可能代表一种有前景的LUAD治疗策略。

documents.title: A Genotype-Phenotype Analysis of Four Chinese Children Carrying Distinct Pathogenic Variants in the CTCF Gene.
meta: Du, Juan; Li, Muhan; Liang, Aimin; Hei, Mingyan; Ren, Xiaotun
Genes
documents.summary: 该文研究CTCF基因变异导致的智力障碍，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: Objective: The objective of this study was to analyze the clinical phenotypes and genetic variant characteristics of four unrelated Chinese children carrying pathogenic variants in the CTCF gene and to explore the genotype-phenotype heterogeneity of autosomal dominant intellectual disability type 21 (MRD21, OMIM 615,502). Methods: Four pediatric patients admitted to Beijing Children's Hospital, Capital Medical University, from 2020 to 2024 were enrolled in this retrospective study. All patients underwent medical history collection, physical examination, laboratory tests and high-throughput sequencing. Identified variants were verified in the probands and parents via Sanger sequencing or CNV-seq. Results: Four distinct heterozygous CTCF variants were identified: a missense variant c.1117C>T (p.His373Tyr); an 8.92 Mb microdeletion at 16q21-q22.1 (arr[GRCh37] 16q21q22.1(58,986,875-67,907,636)x1), encompassing the entire CTCF gene; a frameshift deletion c.615_618delGAAA (p.Lys206Profs*15); and an intragenic deletion of exons 8-10. Parental testing confirmed that all identified variants were of de novo origin. The missense variant and the frameshift deletion have been reported previously in ClinVar (VCV000521287.19 and VCV001308122.2), but the two deletions were not found in public databases. Three patients presented with global developmental delay consistent with MRD21, with variable additional features including autistic-like behavior and facial dysmorphism. Notably, two of these patients showed somatic overgrowth with height and weight above the 97th percentile, contrasting with the short stature classically emphasized in MRD21. The fourth patient was a preterm infant with neonatal chylothorax, cardiopulmonary failure, and multiple congenital cardiovascular malformations; developmental assessment at a corrected age of 11 months showed only mild lags. Conclusions: This study expands the spectrum of pathogenic CTCF variants in the Chinese population and underscores the marked phenotypic heterogeneity of CTCF-related disorders, ranging from benign developmental outcomes with complete catch-up to severe neonatal multisystem involvement. In neonates presenting with unexplained chylothorax and multisystem abnormalities, especially when accompanied by features suggestive of a neurodevelopmental syndrome, CTCF should be considered in the differential diagnosis. Given this heterogeneity, a broad genomic approach rather than targeted CTCF screening is recommended in patients with complex presentations. 目的：分析4例携带CTCF基因致病性变异的不相关中国患儿的临床表型及遗传变异特征，并探讨常染色体显性智力障碍21型（MRD21, OMIM 615,502）的基因型-表型异质性。方法：纳入2020年至2024年首都医科大学附属北京儿童医院收治的4例儿科患者进行回顾性研究。所有患者均接受病史采集、体格检查、实验室检查及高通量测序。通过Sanger测序或CNV-seq在先证者及其父母中验证所鉴定的变异。结果：共鉴定出4种不同的杂合CTCF变异：一个错义变异c.1117C>T（p.His373Tyr）；一个16q21-q22.1的8.92 Mb微缺失（arr[GRCh37] 16q21q22.1(58,986,875-67,907,636)x1），涵盖整个CTCF基因；一个移码缺失c.615_618delGAAA（p.Lys206Profs*15）；以及一个外显子8-10的基因内缺失。父母检测证实所有鉴定变异均为新生起源。错义变异和移码缺失此前已在ClinVar中报道（VCV000521287.19和VCV001308122.2），但两个缺失未在公共数据库中发现。3例患者表现为与MRD21一致的全面发育迟缓，并伴有可变的其他特征，包括自闭症样行为和面部畸形。值得注意的是，其中2例患者表现出躯体过度生长，身高和体重超过第97百分位，与MRD21中经典强调的矮小身材形成对比。第4例患者为早产儿，伴有新生儿乳糜胸、心肺衰竭及多种先天性心血管畸形；在校正年龄11个月时的发育评估仅显示轻度落后。结论：本研究扩展了中国人群中CTCF致病性变异的谱系，并强调了CTCF相关疾病显著的表型异质性，范围从完全追赶的良性发育结局到严重的新生儿多系统受累。在表现为不明原因乳糜胸及多系统异常的新生儿中，尤其是伴有提示神经发育综合征特征时，应考虑将CTCF纳入鉴别诊断。鉴于这种异质性，在复杂表现的患者中建议采用广泛的基因组方法而非靶向CTCF筛查。

documents.title: Disruption of local CTCF binding impairs renin expression and blood pressure response in Dahl salt-sensitive rats.
meta: Vanden Avond, Mark; Grzybowski, Michael N; Kurth, Terry; Yang, Chun; Klotz, Jason; Hantke Guixa, Ana; Greene, Andrew; Rao, Sridhar; Qiu, Qiongzi; Liu, Pengyuan; Liu, Yong; Liang, Mingyu; Cowley, Allen W Jr; Geurts, Aron M
Physiological genomics
documents.summary: 该文研究CTCF结合位点突变对肾素表达和血压的影响，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: Most genetic variants associated with any complex trait are found in non-coding regions. Multiple studies have reported enrichment in single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) found in specific sequences bound by CCCTCF-binding factor (CTCF). CTCF binds DNA to establish boundaries, mediate chromatin interactions and topological domains, and recruit factors to regulate local gene expression. Hypertension is one such disease with enrichment of SNPs in CTCF-binding sites; however, it is not clear whether disruption of CTCF binding to any specific site in the genome could be sufficient to alter blood pressure in vivo. We and others have shown the importance of CTCF-binding and local chromatin interactions governing the renal expression of renin, a critical regulator of systemic blood pressure. Here we developed a model with a mutation to a CTCF-binding motif within first intron of the Ren gene in the Dahl SS rat. CTCF-binding and local chromatin interactions were disrupted, and plasma renin activity (PRA) was impaired when animals were fed a salt-depleted diet in a sex-specific manner, specifically in males. Consistent with the attenuation of PRA, blood pressure was attenuated in male mutant rats during salt depletion. Isolated kidney tissue culture revealed a transcriptional attenuation of Ren expression, suggesting that disruption of CTCF binding within the first intron is critical for initially stabilizing the expression of Ren in response to an inducing stimulus. This is the first demonstration that a mutation to a CTCF-binding site is sufficient to alter a complex physiological trait such as blood pressure regulation, in a sex-specific manner. 大多数与任何复杂性状相关的遗传变异都位于非编码区域。多项研究报告称，在CCCTCF结合因子（CTCF）所结合的特定序列中，单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）存在富集现象。CTCF结合DNA以建立边界、介导染色质相互作用和拓扑结构域，并招募因子以调节局部基因表达。高血压是此类疾病之一，其SNPs在CTCF结合位点中富集；然而，尚不清楚破坏CTCF与基因组中任何特定位点的结合是否足以在体内改变血压。我们及他人已证明，CTCF结合和局部染色质相互作用在调控肾素（renin）的肾脏表达中至关重要，而肾素是全身血压的关键调节因子。在此，我们开发了一个模型，在Dahl SS大鼠的Ren基因第一内含子中引入CTCF结合基序的突变。CTCF结合和局部染色质相互作用被破坏，当动物喂食低盐饮食时，血浆肾素活性（PRA）以性别特异性方式受损，特别是在雄性中。与PRA减弱一致，雄性突变大鼠在低盐期间血压也减弱。分离的肾脏组织培养显示Ren表达转录减弱，表明第一内含子内CTCF结合的破坏对于响应诱导刺激初始稳定Ren表达至关重要。这是首次证明CTCF结合位点的突变足以以性别特异性方式改变诸如血压调节之类的复杂生理性状。

documents.title: Author Correction: Exhausted CD8(+) T cell fate is programmed by dynamic CTCF-mediated enhancer activation and invariant CTCF-imposed barriers.
meta: Hu, Wei; Zhu, Shaoqi; Chen, Qing; Badovinac, Vladimir P; Peng, Weiqun; Xue, Hai-Hui
Nature immunology
documents.summary: 该文为关于CD8+ T细胞耗竭中CTCF介导增强子激活的更正，与cpcdh基因家族无关。

documents.title: Machine learning reveals sequence and genomic context features underlying Alu -specific effects on genome folding.
meta: Zhang, Shu; Pollard, Katherine S
bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
documents.summary: 该文研究Alu转座子对基因组折叠的影响，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联，仅可作为基因组结构分析方法参考。
documents.abstract: The Alu transposable element is among the most abundant classes of mobile DNA in the human genome, and has been linked to gene regulation and chromatin organization. Yet how individual Alu insertions influence nearby chromatin interactions remains poorly understood. To investigate this, we used deep learning to perform a genome-wide in silico deletion screen of ~1.1 million Alus , predicting each element's importance to local genome folding. We identified a subset of high-scoring Alus that span multiple Alu subfamilies and are enriched in loci that are fast-evolving and gene-dense, especially loci encoding genes that are actively transcribed and/or related to Alu biology. We further found that polymorphic Alus preferentially occur in regions tolerant of sequence variation but predicted to be resistant to changes in chromatin structure. Targeted in silico mutagenesis showed that the importance of individual Alus to local chromatin interactions depends on both intrinsic Alu sequence properties and genomic context. Finally, we identified Alu sequences predicted to alter CTCF-mediated boundary strength and, in some cases, to promote the formation of new loops and boundaries. Together, these results position Alus as key modulators of genome architecture, while underscoring that the fate of a new Alu depends on where it inserts and how it interacts with other determinants of chromatin state and structure. documents.abstract:
ABSTRACT

MLL/KMT2A amplifications and rearrangements are prevalent in infant, adult, and therapy-induced leukemia; however, the molecular contributors controlling these alterations remain elusive. Here, we reveal that rapid CTCF degradation generates local genome structure alterations at KMT2A and copy gains and rearrangements. We then established a conserved, coordinated interplay between DNA and histone methylation pathways that control CTCF occupancy, and in turn, KMT2A locus stability. For example, DNMT1 overexpression promotes increased H3K9 methylation, reduced CTCF occupancy, and causes KMT2A alterations. However, DNMT1 inhibition suppresses these events and KMT2A alterations caused by topoisomerase II inhibition. Locus-specific epigenome targeting demonstrated that DNA or H3K9 methylation promotes KMT2A copy gains and rearrangement, whereas targeted TET activity suppresses these events upon methylation perturbation or doxorubicin treatment. These findings identify a conserved, coordinated DNA–histone methylation axis governing KMT2A amplifications and rearrangement susceptibility, revealing biomarkers and therapeutic targets to predict and intercept these events in cancer.

STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE

This study reveals a conserved DNA-histone methylation mechanism controlling the susceptibility of the KMT2A locus to copy gain and rearrange. These events can be generated or prevented by genetic, therapeutic or epigenome editing. Furthermore, DNMT1 inhibition blocks chemotherapy-induced KMT2A disruption, identifying a therapeutic strategy to intercept these oncogenic genomic alterations.

摘要

MLL/KMT2A扩增和重排常见于婴儿、成人及治疗相关白血病中；然而，控制这些改变的分子因素仍不明确。在此，我们揭示快速CTCF降解会在KMT2A位点产生局部基因组结构改变以及拷贝数增加和重排。随后，我们建立了DNA和组蛋白甲基化通路之间保守的协调相互作用，该作用控制CTCF占据，进而影响KMT2A位点稳定性。例如，DNMT1过表达促进H3K9甲基化增加、CTCF占据减少，并导致KMT2A改变。然而，DNMT1抑制可抑制这些事件以及由拓扑异构酶II抑制引起的KMT2A改变。位点特异性表观基因组靶向表明，DNA或H3K9甲基化促进KMT2A拷贝数增加和重排，而靶向TET活性在甲基化扰动或多柔比星处理下抑制这些事件。这些发现识别了一个保守的、协调的DNA-组蛋白甲基化轴，调控KMT2A扩增和重排易感性，揭示了预测和拦截癌症中这些事件的生物标志物和治疗靶点。

意义声明

本研究揭示了一种保守的DNA-组蛋白甲基化机制，控制KMT2A位点对拷贝数增加和重排的易感性。这些事件可通过遗传、治疗或表观基因组编辑产生或预防。此外，DNMT1抑制可阻断化疗诱导的KMT2A破坏，识别了一种拦截这些致癌基因组改变的治疗策略。

documents.abstract: KLF14 acts as a master regulator of gene expression in adipose tissue and variants at the human KLF14 gene show reproducible association with type 2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome. Risk alleles are only pathological when maternally inherited, consistent with the observation that KLF14/Klf14 is a maternally expressed imprinted gene in human and mouse. However, how genomic imprinting is regulated at this important locus is currently unknown. In both species, KLF14/Klf14 is located  approximately 200 kb away from the paternally expressed imprinted gene MEST/Mest, regulated by a maternal gametic differentially methylated region (gDMR) at its promoter. Although the Klf14 promoter is unmethylated in most tissues, maternally inherited DNA methylation marks are paradoxically required for Klf14 expression. Here, we show that Mest and Klf14 reside within the same topologically associating domain (TAD) in embryonic stem cells (ESCs), defined by biallelic CTCF binding at the boundaries. Using allele-specific 4C-seq, we show that CTCF binding to the unmethylated Mest gDMR generates a paternal allele-specific sub-TAD encompassing Klf14 CRISPR-Cas9 deletions of the paternal Mest promoter region in ESCs and in vivo in mutant mice result in loss of Mest expression and acquisition of biallelic expression at Klf14 By analyzing epigenetic marks and chromatin looping in Klf14-expressing pituitary cells, we identify a putative enhancer element shared by Mest and Klf14, providing a mechanistic model for the regulation of Klf14 imprinting. This work defines a new role for the Mest maternally methylated gDMR, revealing that it exerts long-range effects via allele-specific modulation of TAD structures and acts as an imprinting control region in the regulation of Klf14 imprinting. documents.abstract: The Alu transposable element is among the most abundant classes of mobile DNA in the human genome, and has been linked to gene regulation and chromatin organization. Yet how individual Alu insertions influence nearby chromatin interactions remains poorly understood. To investigate this, we used deep learning to perform a genome-wide in silico deletion screen of ~1.1 million Alus , predicting each element's importance to local genome folding. We identified a subset of high-scoring Alus that span multiple Alu subfamilies and are enriched in loci that are fast-evolving and gene-dense, especially loci encoding genes that are actively transcribed and/or related to Alu biology. We further found that polymorphic Alus preferentially occur in regions tolerant of sequence variation but predicted to be resistant to changes in chromatin structure. Targeted in silico mutagenesis showed that the importance of individual Alus to local chromatin interactions depends on both intrinsic Alu sequence properties and genomic context. Finally, we identified Alu sequences predicted to alter CTCF-mediated boundary strength and, in some cases, to promote the formation of new loops and boundaries. Together, these results position Alus as key modulators of genome architecture, while underscoring that the fate of a new Alu depends on where it inserts and how it interacts with other determinants of chromatin state and structure. documents.title: Transcription and Three-Dimensional Genome Organization: Cause, Consequence, or Coordination?
meta: Yang, Dagyeong; Lei, Elissa P
BioEssays : news and reviews in molecular, cellular and developmental biology
documents.summary: 该文综述转录与三维基因组组织的因果关系，虽未直接涉及cpcdh基因家族，但其对染色质结构与基因表达调控的机制探讨可为该家族研究提供借鉴。
documents.abstract: Transcription and three-dimensional (3D) genome organization are closely coupled, but their precise relationship remains unresolved. Evidence from perturbation, imaging, and modeling studies suggests that transcription is not strictly required for the establishment of large-scale genome features such as compartments and topologically associating domains (TADs). Instead, transcription seems to exert more prominent effects at finer spatial scales, where it influences enhancer-promoter interactions, local chromatin loops, and microcompartments. RNA molecules, polymerase-driven supercoiling, and R-loop formation may further modulate chromatin organization at the gene level. At the same time, many architectural proteins and transcriptional regulators operate with functional overlap, complicating efforts to disentangle cause and consequence. Together, these observations suggest that genome architecture provides a relatively stable framework for regulated gene expression, while transcription and associated factors refine chromatin organization in a context-dependent manner. Understanding how these processes are integrated will require systematic, multi-scale perturbations across different biological and biochemical systems. 转录与三维（3D）基因组组织紧密耦合，但二者之间的精确关系仍未明确。来自扰动、成像和建模研究的证据表明，转录并非严格意义上建立区室和拓扑关联结构域（TADs）等大规模基因组特征所必需。相反，转录似乎在更精细的空间尺度上发挥更显著的作用，影响增强子-启动子相互作用、局部染色质环和微区室。RNA分子、聚合酶驱动的超螺旋以及R-loop形成可能进一步在基因水平调节染色质组织。同时，许多结构蛋白和转录调节因子在功能上存在重叠，这使得厘清因果关系变得复杂。综合来看，这些观察结果表明，基因组结构为调控基因表达提供了一个相对稳定的框架，而转录及相关因子则以情境依赖的方式细化染色质组织。理解这些过程如何整合，将需要在不同生物学和生物化学系统中进行系统性的多尺度扰动研究。

documents.title: DiffDomain-Spectrum identifies structurally reorganized TADs from sparse aggregated single-cell Hi-C contact maps
meta: Zhu J; Zhang H; Du Y; Zhang X; Zhou Y; Tian D

documents.summary: 该文研究单细胞Hi-C数据中TAD结构域重组的统计方法，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: Structurally reorganized topologically associating domains (TADs) capture condition- or cell-type-specific remodeling of chromatin contacts and are important for understanding genome organization in health and disease. Emerging single-cell Hi-C (scHi-C) technologies enable such comparisons across heterogeneous cell populations, but aggregated scHi-C contact maps remain sparse at biologically meaningful 25 kb resolution, limiting reliable TAD reorganization detection. Here we present DiffDomain-Spectrum, a spectral statistical framework for identifying reorganized TADs between conditions or cell types from aggregated raw scHi-C contact maps. It tests normalized TAD-level difference matrices without separately normalizing sparse maps or enhancing individual scHi-C contact maps. Comparison with a semicircle-law null integrates evidence across the full eigenvalue spectrum. Across multiple scHi-C platforms, DiffDomain-Spectrum balances false positive control and detection sensitivity relative to alternative bulk callers, and detects a substantially higher proportion of reference TADs as reorganized than the boundary-focused single-cell method scHiCluster. Detected TADs show coherent aggregate contact patterns and CTCF binding changes and are enriched for differentially expressed genes, supporting biological relevance. Together, these results establish DiffDomain-Spectrum as a statistically principled framework for comparative domain-level analysis of sparse aggregated scHi-C contact maps without single-cell map enhancement. 结构重组的拓扑关联结构域（TADs）捕捉条件或细胞类型特异性的染色质接触重塑，对于理解健康和疾病中的基因组组织至关重要。新兴的单细胞Hi-C（scHi-C）技术能够在异质细胞群体间进行此类比较，但聚合的scHi-C接触图谱在生物学意义的25 kb分辨率下仍显稀疏，限制了可靠的TAD重组检测。在此，我们提出DiffDomain-Spectrum，一种光谱统计框架，用于从聚合的原始scHi-C接触图谱中识别条件或细胞类型间重组的TADs。它直接检验归一化的TAD水平差异矩阵，无需单独归一化稀疏图谱或增强单个scHi-C接触图谱。与半圆律零假设的比较整合了全特征值谱的证据。在多个scHi-C平台上，DiffDomain-Spectrum相对于替代的批量调用器在假阳性控制和检测灵敏度之间取得平衡，并且检测到参考TADs中重组比例显著高于以边界为重点的单细胞方法scHiCluster。检测到的TADs显示出一致的聚合接触模式和CTCF结合变化，并富集差异表达基因，支持其生物学相关性。综合来看，这些结果确立了DiffDomain-Spectrum作为一种统计原则性框架，用于稀疏聚合scHi-C接触图谱的域级比较分析，而无需单细胞图谱增强。

documents.title: Disruption of CTCF-mediated IGF2 repression promotes AKT-dependent mitochondrial oxidative stress and chondrocyte senescence in osteoarthritis.
meta: Zhang, Chunpan; Xu, Fei; Wu, Jiangping; Zhu, Lixuan; Ning, Jie; Wu, Qishun
Life sciences
documents.summary: 该文研究CTCF-IGF2调控轴在骨关节炎软骨细胞衰老中的作用，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: AIMS: The upstream epigenetic mechanisms linking chronic inflammation to mitochondrial dysregulation and chondrocyte senescence in osteoarthritis (OA) remain incompletely defined. This study investigated whether inflammation-associated loss of CTCF occupancy at the IGF2-H19 intergenic region contributes to IGF2 upregulation, AKT-dependent mitochondrial oxidative stress, and chondrocyte senescence. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Integrative transcriptomic analysis of GSE114007 was performed using DESeq2, WGCNA, and protein-protein interaction network analysis. Key findings were examined in human OA cartilage and mechanistically investigated in cytokine-stimulated C28/I2 chondrocytes using chromatin immunoprecipitation, mitochondrial functional profiling, and senescence assays. Mechanistic studies combined CTCF gain- and loss-of-function approaches with pharmacological targeting of IGF2, AKT, and mitochondrial ROS. IGF2 neutralization was further evaluated in an ACLT murine model. KEY FINDINGS: IGF2 emerged as a transcriptomic hub gene associated with mitochondrial and senescence-related networks in OA. Inflammatory stimulation reduced CTCF expression and occupancy at the IGF2-H19 intergenic region, accompanied by increased IGF2 expression, AKT activation, mitochondrial respiratory activity, ROS production, matrix catabolism, and senescence-associated phenotypes. CTCF overexpression attenuated IGF2 upregulation and oxidative/senescence-associated phenotypes, whereas CTCF knockdown elicited complementary changes. Targeting IGF2, AKT, or mitochondrial ROS reduced oxidative stress and senescence-associated changes. In vivo, IGF2 neutralization attenuated cartilage degeneration, matrix catabolism, AKT activation, and senescence-associated alterations. SIGNIFICANCE: These findings support a functional regulatory framework linking CTCF-IGF2 dysregulation with AKT-dependent mitochondrial oxidative stress and chondrocyte senescence in OA, highlighting IGF2 signaling as a potential therapeutic target. 目的：在骨关节炎（OA）中，将慢性炎症与线粒体失调和软骨细胞衰老联系起来的上游表观遗传机制尚未完全明确。本研究探讨了炎症相关的CTCF在IGF2-H19基因间区域占据率丧失是否导致IGF2上调、AKT依赖性线粒体氧化应激及软骨细胞衰老。材料与方法：使用DESeq2、WGCNA和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析对GSE114007进行整合转录组学分析。关键发现在人类OA软骨中进行了检测，并在细胞因子刺激的C28/I2软骨细胞中通过染色质免疫沉淀、线粒体功能分析和衰老测定进行了机制研究。机制研究结合了CTCF功能获得和功能丧失方法，以及针对IGF2、AKT和线粒体ROS的药理学靶向。在ACLT小鼠模型中进一步评估了IGF2中和作用。主要发现：IGF2被确定为与OA中线粒体和衰老相关网络相关的转录组枢纽基因。炎症刺激降低了CTCF在IGF2-H19基因间区域的表达和占据率，伴随IGF2表达增加、AKT激活、线粒体呼吸活性增强、ROS产生增多、基质分解代谢增强及衰老相关表型。CTCF过表达减弱了IGF2上调及氧化/衰老相关表型，而CTCF敲低则引发互补性变化。靶向IGF2、AKT或线粒体ROS可减少氧化应激和衰老相关变化。在体内，IGF2中和作用减轻了软骨退化、基质分解代谢、AKT激活及衰老相关改变。意义：这些发现支持一个功能调控框架，将CTCF-IGF2失调与OA中AKT依赖性线粒体氧化应激和软骨细胞衰老联系起来，突出IGF2信号作为潜在治疗靶点。

documents.title: DNAM-1-Stimulated NK-92 Cells Exert Preferential Cytotoxic and Apoptosis-Associated Effects on Hormone-Independent Solid Tumor Cell Lines.
meta: Dastouri, Mohammadreza; Elmusa, Fatima
International journal of molecular sciences
documents.summary: 该文研究抗CD226刺激的NK-92细胞对激素非依赖性实体瘤的细胞毒作用，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联，仅涉及CD226（与cpcdh名称相似但不同），可借鉴其凋亡检测方法。
documents.abstract: Anti-CD226 antibody-mediated stimulation of NK-92 cells (sNK-92) represents a potential immunotherapeutic approach; however, its cytotoxic and apoptosis-associated effects in hormone-independent solid tumors remain insufficiently characterized. This study investigated the activity of sNK-92 cells against PC3 castration-resistant prostate cancer and SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cell lines, using PNT1A normal prostate epithelial and BJ normal dermal fibroblast cells as non-malignant controls. Cytotoxicity was assessed by CCK-8 assay at target-to-effector (T:E) ratios of 1:1, 1:5, and 1:10, and markers historically associated with the intrinsic (BAX, caspase-9), extrinsic (caspase-8), and executioner (caspase-3) apoptotic pathways were evaluated quantitatively by ImageJ-based corrected total cell fluorescence (CTCF) analysis. sNK-92 cells produced significant ratio-dependent cytotoxicity against PC3 and SH-SY5Y cells, reaching 23.76% and 26.29%, respectively, at the 1:10 T:E ratio, with sNK-92 producing significantly greater cytotoxicity than unstimulated NK-92 at this ratio in both cell lines and additionally at the 1:5 ratio in SH-SY5Y cells; no significant reduction in CCK-8 viability was detected in PNT1A or BJ cells at any ratio. Quantitative immunofluorescence analysis demonstrated substantially increased relative fluorescence intensity of all four apoptosis-associated markers in sNK-92-treated PC3 and SH-SY5Y cells compared with their corresponding controls and, in most comparisons, with NK-92-treated cells, whereas changes observed in the PNT1A and BJ non-malignant models examined were markedly smaller. These findings provide preliminary quantitative evidence that anti-CD226-stimulated NK-92 cells exert a preferential cytotoxic effect on the tumor cell models examined, relative to the non-malignant models tested, and induce changes in apoptosis-associated markers consistent with engagement of apoptotic signaling. Further orthogonal validation is warranted. 抗CD226抗体介导的NK-92细胞（sNK-92）刺激代表了一种潜在的免疫治疗方法；然而，其在激素非依赖性实体瘤中的细胞毒性和凋亡相关效应仍未得到充分表征。本研究调查了sNK-92细胞对PC3去势抵抗性前列腺癌和SH-SY5Y神经母细胞瘤细胞系的活性，使用PNT1A正常前列腺上皮细胞和BJ正常真皮成纤维细胞作为非恶性对照。通过CCK-8实验在靶细胞与效应细胞（T:E）比例为1:1、1:5和1:10时评估细胞毒性，并通过基于ImageJ的校正总细胞荧光（CTCF）分析定量评估历史上与内源性（BAX、caspase-9）、外源性（caspase-8）和效应子（caspase-3）凋亡通路相关的标志物。sNK-92细胞对PC3和SH-SY5Y细胞产生显著的比例依赖性细胞毒性，在1:10 T:E比例下分别达到23.76%和26.29%，且在此比例下，sNK-92在两种细胞系中均比未刺激的NK-92产生显著更高的细胞毒性，并在SH-SY5Y细胞中额外在1:5比例下也显著更高；在PNT1A或BJ细胞中，任何比例下均未检测到CCK-8活力的显著降低。定量免疫荧光分析显示，与相应对照组相比，sNK-92处理的PC3和SH-SY5Y细胞中所有四种凋亡相关标志物的相对荧光强度显著增加，且在大多数比较中，与NK-92处理的细胞相比也显著增加，而在所检查的PNT1A和BJ非恶性模型中观察到的变化明显较小。这些发现提供了初步的定量证据，表明抗CD226刺激的NK-92细胞对所检查的肿瘤细胞模型相对于所测试的非恶性模型表现出优先的细胞毒性效应，并诱导与凋亡信号传导参与一致的凋亡相关标志物变化。进一步的正交验证是有必要的。

documents.title: PRMT1-Mediated Arginine Methylation Redirects SMAD4 Signaling to Promote Metastasis in Pancreatic Cancer.
meta: Liu, Yizhou; Liang, Xueyi; Wei, Ruozheng; Peng, Yu; Qin, Gengdu; Liu, Jiaying; Zhao, Yuhan; Cai, Hongkun; Chen, Taoyu; Gou, Shanmiao; Yin, Tao; Wang, Bo; Wu, Heshui; Zhou, Yingke
Cancer research
documents.summary: 该文研究PRMT1介导的SMAD4甲基化在胰腺癌转移中的作用，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by early metastatic dissemination and poor clinical outcomes. Although SMAD4 is frequently altered in PDAC, the majority of tumors retain wild-type SMAD4, which paradoxically acquires pro-metastatic functions during disease progression. Uncovering how SMAD4 transcriptional output is reprogrammed to support metastasis in advanced PDAC could reveal strategies to prevent and treat metastasis. Here, we identified protein arginine methyltransferase 1 (PRMT1) as a critical modifier that mediates a metastasis-promoting transcriptional state of SMAD4. PRMT1 catalyzed asymmetric dimethylation of SMAD4 at arginine 272 (R272), a modification that did not alter SMAD4 expression but stabilized nuclear SMAD2/3-SMAD4 complexes and redirected SMAD4 chromatin engagement toward epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) gene programs. Mechanistically, R272-methylated SMAD4 promoted the recruitment of a BRG1-CTCF transcriptional complex, enabling chromatin-dependent activation of pro-metastatic transcriptional outputs. Importantly, pharmacological inhibition of PRMT1, particularly in combination with BRG1 degradation, dismantled methylation-dependent SMAD4 transcriptional complexes, suppressed EMT programs, and markedly reduced liver metastasis in preclinical PDAC models. Together, these findings uncover a post-translational mechanism that governs SMAD4 transcriptional specificity and identify PRMT1-dependent methylation as a therapeutic vulnerability in SMAD4-wild-type pancreatic cancer. 胰腺导管腺癌（pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, PDAC）以早期转移播散和不良临床结局为特征。尽管SMAD4在PDAC中频繁发生改变，但大多数肿瘤保留野生型SMAD4，这矛盾地使其在疾病进展过程中获得促转移功能。揭示SMAD4转录输出如何在晚期PDAC中被重编程以支持转移，可能为预防和治疗转移提供策略。在此，我们鉴定了蛋白质精氨酸甲基转移酶1（protein arginine methyltransferase 1, PRMT1）作为关键修饰因子，介导SMAD4的促转移转录状态。PRMT1催化SMAD4在精氨酸272（R272）位点的非对称二甲基化，该修饰不改变SMAD4表达，但稳定核内SMAD2/3-SMAD4复合物，并将SMAD4染色质结合重定向至上皮-间质转化（epithelial-mesenchymal transition, EMT）基因程序。机制上，R272甲基化的SMAD4促进BRG1-CTCF转录复合物的招募，实现染色质依赖的促转移转录输出激活。重要的是，药理学抑制PRMT1，特别是与BRG1降解联合使用时，可瓦解甲基化依赖的SMAD4转录复合物，抑制EMT程序，并在临床前PDAC模型中显著减少肝转移。综上，这些发现揭示了一种调控SMAD4转录特异性的翻译后机制，并将PRMT1依赖性甲基化鉴定为SMAD4野生型胰腺癌的治疗脆弱点。

documents.title: Regulation of immune signal integration and memory by inflammation-induced chromosome conformation.
meta: Daniel, Bence; Chen, Andy Y; Sandor, Katalin; Zhang, Wenxi; Miao, Zhuang; Yost, Kathryn E; Lareau, Caleb A; Chang, Howard Y; Satpathy, Ansuman T
Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
documents.summary: 该文研究巨噬细胞炎症反应中三维基因组构象对转录调控的作用，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) genome conformation is central to gene expression regulation, yet our understanding of its contribution to rapid transcriptional responses, signal integration, and memory in immune cells is limited. Here, we study the molecular regulation of the inflammatory response in primary macrophages using integrated transcriptomic, epigenomic, and chromosome conformation data, including base pair-resolution Micro Capture-C. We demonstrate that interleukin-4 (IL-4) primes the inflammatory response in macrophages by stably rewiring 3D genome conformation, juxtaposing endotoxin-, interferon-gamma-, and dexamethasone-responsive enhancers to their cognate gene promoters. CRISPR-based perturbations of enhancer-promoter contacts or CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF) boundary elements show that IL-4-driven conformation changes are required for enhanced and synergistic endotoxin-induced transcriptional responses, as well as transcriptional memory following stimulus removal. Moreover, transcriptional memory mediated by changes in chromosome conformation can occur in the absence of changes in chromatin accessibility or histone modifications. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that rapid and memory transcriptional responses to immunological stimuli are encoded in the 3D genome. 三维（3D）基因组构象对基因表达调控至关重要，然而我们对其在免疫细胞快速转录响应、信号整合及记忆中的作用了解有限。在此，我们利用整合的转录组学、表观基因组学和染色体构象数据，包括碱基对分辨率的Micro Capture-C，研究原代巨噬细胞中炎症反应的分子调控机制。我们证明，白细胞介素-4（IL-4）通过稳定重塑3D基因组构象，将内毒素、干扰素-γ和地塞米松响应性增强子与其同源基因启动子并置，从而为巨噬细胞中的炎症反应提供启动。基于CRISPR的增强子-启动子接触或CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）边界元件扰动实验表明，IL-4驱动的构象变化对于增强和协同的内毒素诱导转录响应，以及刺激移除后的转录记忆是必需的。此外，由染色体构象变化介导的转录记忆可以在染色质可及性或组蛋白修饰无变化的情况下发生。总体而言，这些发现表明，对免疫刺激的快速和记忆性转录响应编码在3D基因组中。

documents.title: dcHiChIP: A comprehensive Nextflow-based pipeline for multiscale analysis of chromatin architecture from HiChIP data.
meta: Agarwal, Abhishek; Al Bkhetan, Ziad; Plewczynski, Dariusz
Bioinformatics (Oxford, England)
documents.summary: 该文介绍了一个用于HiChIP数据染色质架构分析的流程，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联，但可能为相关研究提供技术参考。
documents.abstract: MOTIVATION: Despite the growing use of HiChIP to investigate protein-directed chromatin architecture, a comprehensive and reproducible pipeline for analyzing these datasets-from raw reads to multiscale 3D genome features-remains lacking. Existing tools often focus on isolated components, such as loop calling or matrix generation, but fall short in integrating structural annotation, functional enrichment, and spatial modeling within a unified framework. To address this gap, we developed dcHiChIP, a modular, scalable Nextflow-based workflow that streamlines the analysis of HiChIP data, enabling both routine processing and in-depth exploration of chromatin organization and regulatory interactions. RESULTS: dcHiChIP enables robust and reproducible analysis of HiChIP datasets across multiple scales of chromatin architecture. It accepts raw sequencing data as input and generates high-quality loop calls, domain annotations, and 3D genome models. It also performs functional annotation and motif enrichment analyses. Applied to benchmark CTCF HiChIP datasets, dcHiChIP identifies major chromatin architectural features such as TADs/CCDs, A/B compartments, and chromatin stripes, and offers efficient, end-to-end execution with support for batch processing and workflow resumability. AVAILABILITY: dcHiChIP is publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/SFGLab/dcHiChIP, with documentation at https://sfglab.github.io/dcHiChIP/. The software version used in this study is archived at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22030542. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online. 动机：尽管HiChIP在探究蛋白质导向的染色质结构中的应用日益增多，但目前仍缺乏一个全面且可重复的流程，用于分析这些数据集——从原始读段到多尺度3D基因组特征。现有工具通常聚焦于孤立组件，如环检测或矩阵生成，但未能将结构注释、功能富集和空间建模整合到一个统一框架中。为填补这一空白，我们开发了dcHiChIP，这是一个模块化、可扩展的基于Nextflow的工作流程，可简化HiChIP数据的分析，支持常规处理以及对染色质组织和调控相互作用的深入探索。结果：dcHiChIP能够在染色质架构的多尺度上对HiChIP数据集进行稳健且可重复的分析。它接受原始测序数据作为输入，并生成高质量的环检测、结构域注释和3D基因组模型。它还执行功能注释和基序富集分析。应用于基准CTCF HiChIP数据集时，dcHiChIP识别出主要的染色质结构特征，如TADs/CCDs、A/B compartments和染色质条纹，并提供高效、端到端的执行，支持批量处理和工作流可恢复性。可用性：dcHiChIP在GitHub上公开可用，网址为https://github.com/SFGLab/dcHiChIP，文档位于https://sfglab.github.io/dcHiChIP/。本研究中使用的软件版本已存档于Zenodo：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22030542。补充信息：补充数据可在Bioinformatics在线获取。

documents.title: Fermentation of mulberry leaf extract by Aspergillus chevalieri CTCF-AC-1 for flavor improvement and enhanced hypoglycemic activity.
meta: Li, Xuezhen; He, Fatao; Lv, Xuqiang; Ma, Yanrui; Meng, Yuan; Lu, Xueyao; Zhao, Yan; Tian, Jiewei; Liu, Guangpeng; Wu, Maoyu
International journal of food microbiology
documents.summary: 该文研究桑叶提取物经真菌发酵改善风味和降糖活性，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: Mulberry leaf extract (MLE) is rich in bioactive compounds with potent hypoglycemic activity, but is constrained by its sensory drawbacks. In this study, Aspergillus chevalieri CTCF-AC-1, isolated from Fu brick tea, was employed to ferment MLE for improving both its flavor profile and functional efficacy. Fermentation dynamically remodeled MLE composition: total phenolic acids decreased from 859.8 to 566.5 mg/mL, while total amino acid content increased dramatically from 322.13 mg/mL to 570.31 mg/mL with methionine and cysteine increased by 111.5-fold and 5.4-fold, respectively. The content of 1-deoxynojirimycin (1-DNJ) remained stable (0.27-0.29 mg/g). Headspace-gas chromatography-ion mobility spectrometry (HS-GC-IMS) analysis identified 62 volatile compounds, revealing a reduction in bitter/astringent notes (2,3,5-trimethylpyrazine, butyric acid, etc.) and an increase in compounds associated with fruity and sweet aromas (d-3-hexanone, 2,3-dimethylpyrazine etc.). Furthermore, the fermented MLE (FMLE) exhibited significantly enhanced in vitro antioxidant activity and inhibitory effects on alpha-amylase and alpha-glucosidase. In a zebrafish hyperglycemia model, FMLE showed lower acute toxicity (LC(1) = 1109 mug/mL vs. 609 mug/mL for MLE) and superior efficacy in promoting pancreatic glucose uptake in a dose-dependent manner. Transcriptomic and QPCR analyses elucidated that FMLE's hypoglycemic mechanism involves regulation of key genes (fut9d, irg1l, mmp9, gck) implicated in glucose metabolism and immune response. These findings demonstrate that fermentation with A. chevalieri effectively alleviates the sensory limitations of MLE while enhancing its hypoglycemic potency and biocompatibility, providing a scientific basis for its use in functional foods and nutraceuticals. 桑叶提取物（MLE）富含具有强效降糖活性的生物活性化合物，但其感官缺陷限制了其应用。本研究利用从茯砖茶中分离的 Aspergillus chevalieri CTCF-AC-1 发酵 MLE，以改善其风味特征和功能功效。发酵动态重塑了 MLE 的组成：总酚酸从 859.8 mg/mL 降至 566.5 mg/mL，而总氨基酸含量从 322.13 mg/mL 显著增加至 570.31 mg/mL，其中蛋氨酸和半胱氨酸分别增加了 111.5 倍和 5.4 倍。1-脱氧野尻霉素（1-DNJ）含量保持稳定（0.27-0.29 mg/g）。顶空气相色谱-离子迁移谱（HS-GC-IMS）分析鉴定出 62 种挥发性化合物，显示苦味/涩味相关化合物（2,3,5-三甲基吡嗪、丁酸等）减少，而果香和甜香相关化合物（d-3-己酮、2,3-二甲基吡嗪等）增加。此外，发酵 MLE（FMLE）表现出显著增强的体外抗氧化活性以及对 α-淀粉酶和 α-葡萄糖苷酶的抑制效果。在斑马鱼高血糖模型中，FMLE 显示出较低的急性毒性（LC(1) = 1109 μg/mL，而 MLE 为 609 μg/mL），并以剂量依赖方式促进胰腺葡萄糖摄取，表现出更优功效。转录组和 QPCR 分析阐明，FMLE 的降糖机制涉及调节与葡萄糖代谢和免疫反应相关的关键基因（fut9d、irg1l、mmp9、gck）。这些发现表明，A. chevalieri 发酵有效缓解了 MLE 的感官限制，同时增强了其降糖效力和生物相容性，为其在功能食品和营养保健品中的应用提供了科学依据。

documents.title: Nanoliposomal curcumin as a potential pro-apoptotic agent for cervical cancer: Evidence from Bcl-2 and Bax modulation in HeLa cells.
meta: Subandi, Subandi; Aisyah, Oktalia N; Lestari, Bayu
Narra J
documents.summary: 该文研究纳米脂质体姜黄素对宫颈癌细胞凋亡蛋白Bcl-2/Bax的调控，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: Cervical cancer remains a major cause of cancer-related mortality, and treatment effectiveness is often limited by drug resistance and systemic toxicity. Curcumin has shown anticancer activity, but its clinical translation is constrained by poor solubility and low bioavailability. Nanoliposomal curcumin (Cur-NLPs) may improve intracellular delivery; however, its dose-dependent effect on apoptosis-related proteins in cervical cancer cells remains insufficiently defined. This study evaluated the dose-dependent modulation of Bcl-2 and Bax protein expression by Cur-NLPs in HeLa cells. HeLa cells were assigned to five groups: negative control, cisplatin 5 microg/mL as positive control, and Cur-NLPs at 100, 150, and 200 microg/mL. After 24 hours of treatment, Bcl-2 and Bax expression were assessed by immunofluorescence and quantified as corrected total cell fluorescence (CTCF). Data were analyzed using one-way ANOVA, Tukey HSD post hoc test, Pearson correlation, and linear regression. Significant between-group differences were observed for both Bcl-2 (F=8.99; p=0.002) and Bax (F=132.38; p<0.001). Cur-NLPs progressively reduced Bcl-2 expression and increased Bax expression, with the most pronounced effect observed at 200 microg/mL. Bcl-2 expression at 200 microg/mL and Bax expression at 150-200 microg/mL were significantly altered compared with the negative control, while the 200 microg/mL dose showed no significant difference from cisplatin for either marker. Cur-NLPs concentration showed a strong negative correlation with Bcl-2 expression (r=-0.847; p<0.001) and a strong positive correlation with Bax expression (r=0.942; p<0.001). Linear regression further confirmed dose-dependent effects, with Cur-NLPs concentration explaining 79.6% and 88.8% of the variance in Bcl-2 and Bax expression, respectively. These findings indicate that Cur-NLPs can shift the Bcl-2/Bax balance toward a pro-apoptotic profile in HeLa cells, supporting its potential as a curcumin-based nanodelivery strategy for cervical cancer. Further studies using functional apoptosis assays, additional cervical cancer cell lines, and in vivo models are needed to confirm its translational relevance. 宫颈癌仍然是癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，而治疗效果常受限于耐药性和全身毒性。姜黄素（curcumin）已显示出抗癌活性，但其临床转化受制于溶解性差和生物利用度低。纳米脂质体姜黄素（nanoliposomal curcumin, Cur-NLPs）可能改善细胞内递送；然而，其对宫颈癌细胞中凋亡相关蛋白的剂量依赖性效应仍未得到充分定义。本研究评估了Cur-NLPs在HeLa细胞中对Bcl-2和Bax蛋白表达的剂量依赖性调节作用。HeLa细胞被分为五组：阴性对照组、顺铂（cisplatin）5微克/毫升作为阳性对照组，以及Cur-NLPs 100、150和200微克/毫升组。处理24小时后，通过免疫荧光（immunofluorescence）评估Bcl-2和Bax表达，并量化为校正总细胞荧光（corrected total cell fluorescence, CTCF）。数据采用单因素方差分析（one-way ANOVA）、Tukey HSD事后检验、Pearson相关分析和线性回归进行分析。Bcl-2（F=8.99；p=0.002）和Bax（F=132.38；p<0.001）均观察到显著的组间差异。Cur-NLPs逐渐降低Bcl-2表达并增加Bax表达，在200微克/毫升时观察到最显著的效果。与阴性对照组相比，200微克/毫升时的Bcl-2表达和150-200微克/毫升时的Bax表达显著改变，而200微克/毫升剂量在两种标志物上与顺铂相比均无显著差异。Cur-NLPs浓度与Bcl-2表达呈强负相关（r=-0.847；p<0.001），与Bax表达呈强正相关（r=0.942；p<0.001）。线性回归进一步确认了剂量依赖性效应，Cur-NLPs浓度分别解释了Bcl-2和Bax表达变异的79.6%和88.8%。这些发现表明，Cur-NLPs能在HeLa细胞中将Bcl-2/Bax平衡转向促凋亡特征，支持其作为基于姜黄素的纳米递送策略用于宫颈癌的潜力。未来需采用功能性凋亡检测、更多宫颈癌细胞系和体内模型进行进一步研究，以确认其转化相关性。

documents.title: Selective control of HLA-DRB1 and HLA-DQA1 transcription through DR/DQ super enhancer microelements.
meta: Majumder, Parimal; Lee, Joshua; Butler, Royce; Scharer, Christopher D; Boss, Jeremy M
Cell reports
documents.summary: 该文研究MHC-II基因的转录调控，与cpcdh基因家族无关，但涉及基因表达调控机制可借鉴。
documents.abstract: MHC-II gene expression requires promoter-proximal and distal organizing elements. A super enhancer located between the HLA-DR and -DQ genes was dissected into five microdomains (regions A-E) to define its mechanism of action. Regions A and B were required for maximal expression of HLA-DQA1. Region A facilitated HLA-DQA1 expression and substituted for region B in its absence, as well as mediating longer-range interactions with distal CTCF sites. Region D modulated HLA-DRB1 through specific 3D chromatin interactions, whereas a local insulator element (XL9) broadly interacted with the SE. Through deletion of HLA-DRB1 proximal-promoter elements, HLA-DQ expression increased by co-opting interactions with region D, indicating that competition between microelements regulates the absolute levels of MHC-II genes. Together, these data define an additional layer of control for MHC-II genes encoded in one of the most polymorphic and disease-associated regions of the human genome. MHC-II基因表达需要启动子近端和远端的组织元件。位于HLA-DR和-DQ基因之间的超级增强子被分解为五个微结构域（区域A-E），以明确其作用机制。区域A和B是HLA-DQA1最大表达所必需的。区域A促进HLA-DQA1表达，并在区域B缺失时替代其功能，同时介导与远端CTCF位点的更长程相互作用。区域D通过特定的3D染色质相互作用调节HLA-DRB1，而一个局部绝缘子元件（XL9）与SE广泛相互作用。通过删除HLA-DRB1近端启动子元件，HLA-DQ表达通过共选区域D的相互作用而增加，表明微元件之间的竞争调节MHC-II基因的绝对水平。综合来看，这些数据定义了人类基因组中一个最具多态性和疾病关联区域中编码的MHC-II基因的额外调控层。

documents.title: Genetic mechanisms of mitotic error in 840,853 blood genomes
meta: Si Y; Kamitaki N; Tang D; Loh P
medRxiv
documents.summary: 该文研究血液基因组中嵌合非整倍体的遗传机制，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
documents.abstract: Mosaic aneuploidies in leukocytes are commonly detectable in aging individuals. Here, we studied inherited genetic influences on susceptibility to such aneuploidies by precisely quantifying chromosomal ploidy from whole-genome sequencing read-depth in 840,853 individuals. This approach revealed autosomal gains in ∼70,000 individuals (7-fold more than previous data sets) and ubiquitous loss of the X chromosome in females and loss of Y in males, each of which exhibited > 50% heritability. Genome-wide association analyses of 12 mosaic aneuploidies identified > 800 common inherited influences on the generation and proliferation of aneuploid cells. Variants in mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint genes consistently affected aneuploidy of most chromosomes, whereas a missense variant in PMF1 (which encodes a subunit of the outer kinetochore) associated with increased segregation fidelity of some chromosomes at the expense of others. Structural variation within multiple chromosomes associated with allele-specific effects on missegregation rates. An inherited hybrid centromere formed by an ancient recombination of 22q with 13p—generating the largest common structural variant in the human genome—associated with 4-fold greater risk of chromosome 22 gain. Abundant copy number and sequence variation in two X-linked CTCF-binding repeat arrays, ICCE and DXZ4 , associated with a 4-fold range in the likelihoods of different X chromosomes to be lost. These results show how genetic risk of chromosomal gains and losses varies greatly across chromosomes and across people, providing instruments for assessing the effects of mosaic aneuploidies on health. 白细胞中的嵌合体非整倍体（mosaic aneuploidies）在衰老个体中普遍可检测到。本研究通过精确量化840,853名个体的全基因组测序读深（whole-genome sequencing read-depth）中的染色体倍性（chromosomal ploidy），探讨了遗传因素对此类非整倍体易感性的影响。该方法揭示了约70,000名个体中的常染色体获得（autosomal gains）（比以往数据集多7倍），以及女性中X染色体的普遍缺失和男性中Y染色体的普遍缺失，每种情况均表现出>50%的遗传度（heritability）。对12种嵌合体非整倍体的全基因组关联分析（genome-wide association analyses）识别出>800个影响非整倍体细胞生成与增殖的常见遗传因素。有丝分裂纺锤体组装检查点（mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint）基因的变异一致地影响大多数染色体的非整倍体，而PMF1（编码外动粒（outer kinetochore）亚基）中的一个错义变异（missense variant）与某些染色体分离保真度（segregation fidelity）的增加相关，但以其他染色体的保真度为代价。多个染色体内的结构变异（structural variation）与错误分离率（missegregation rates）的等位基因特异性效应（allele-specific effects）相关。一个由22q与13p的古老重组形成的遗传性杂合着丝粒（inherited hybrid centromere）——产生了人类基因组中最大的常见结构变异——与染色体22获得的风险增加4倍相关。两个X连锁的CTCF结合重复序列阵列（CTCF-binding repeat arrays）ICCE和DXZ4中的丰富拷贝数变异（copy number variation）和序列变异（sequence variation），与不同X染色体丢失可能性的4倍范围相关。这些结果表明，染色体获得与丢失的遗传风险在不同染色体之间以及不同个体之间差异巨大，为评估嵌合体非整倍体对健康的影响提供了工具。

documents.title: A lipoprotein-responsive circular RNA, circCTCF, couples extracellular lipid availability to mTOR signaling via ACSL5 in triple-negative breast cancer.
meta: Zhang, Yuanyuan; Liu, Zhengyi; Su, Xuanyi; Hu, Xinyuan; Zhang, Qing; Zhang, Huiyang; Shicao, Duan; Cheng, Linna; Zhang, Xu Dong; Liu, Xiaoying; Chen, Song; Thorne, Rick F
International journal of biological macromolecules
documents.summary: 该文研究circCTCF在乳腺癌中调控脂质代谢和mTOR信号，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive subtype with limited therapeutic options. While metabolic reprogramming is a hallmark of cancer, most studies have focused on cell-intrinsic alterations in glucose and amino acid metabolism, with comparatively little attention paid to how cancer cells sense and respond to extracellular lipid availability. Here, through an unbiased transcriptomic and circRNA profiling screen under lipoprotein-deprived conditions, we identify circCTCF, a circular RNA derived from the CTCF gene, as a lipoprotein-responsive regulator of lipid metabolism and proliferation in TNBC. circCTCF is significantly downregulated upon lipid withdrawal, and its depletion impairs cell growth while promoting lipid droplet accumulation. Conversely, circCTCF overexpression enhances proliferation and suppresses lipid storage. Mechanistically, circCTCF binds the RNA-binding protein G3BP2 through its back-splice junction sequence to stabilize ACSL5 mRNA, thereby sustaining ACSL5 expression, phosphatidic acid (PA) levels, and mTOR signaling. ACSL5 overexpression rescues PA and mTOR activity in circCTCF-deficient cells, establishing a linear circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR axis. Furthermore, circCTCF associates with G3BP2-positive stress granules upon heat shock, suggesting a potential link between this metabolic axis and stress-induced RNA regulatory networks. Collectively, these findings establish circCTCF as a critical node coupling extracellular lipid cues to intracellular metabolic control and identify the circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR axis as a potential therapeutic vulnerability in TNBC. 三阴性乳腺癌（triple-negative breast cancer, TNBC）是一种侵袭性亚型，治疗选择有限。尽管代谢重编程是癌症的一个标志，但大多数研究聚焦于葡萄糖和氨基酸代谢的细胞内在改变，相对较少关注癌细胞如何感知和响应细胞外脂质可用性。在此，通过在脂蛋白剥夺条件下进行无偏转录组和circRNA谱筛选，我们鉴定出circCTCF——一种源自CTCF基因的环状RNA——作为TNBC中脂质代谢和增殖的脂蛋白响应性调控因子。circCTCF在脂质剥夺后显著下调，其缺失会损害细胞生长，同时促进脂滴积累。相反，circCTCF过表达增强增殖并抑制脂质储存。机制上，circCTCF通过其反向剪接连接序列结合RNA结合蛋白G3BP2，以稳定ACSL5 mRNA，从而维持ACSL5表达、磷脂酸（phosphatidic acid, PA）水平和mTOR信号传导。ACSL5过表达可恢复circCTCF缺陷细胞中的PA和mTOR活性，建立一条线性的circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR轴。此外，circCTCF在热休克下与G3BP2阳性应激颗粒结合，提示该代谢轴与应激诱导的RNA调控网络之间存在潜在联系。总体而言，这些发现确立了circCTCF作为耦合细胞外脂质信号与细胞内代谢控制的关键节点，并确定circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR轴是TNBC中一个潜在的治疗脆弱点。

documents.title: Allele-specific chromatin architecture shapes imprinted domains and coordinates a distal enhancer and antisense transcription at the mouse Mest-Copg2 domain.
meta: Bae, Bongmin; Gu, Katherine; Loftus, Daniel; Whipple, Amanda J
Nature communications
documents.summary: 该文研究小鼠Mest-Copg2印记域中等位基因特异性染色质结构如何调控印记表达，虽未直接研究cpcdh基因家族，但提供了印记调控机制和染色质构象分析的重要借鉴。
documents.abstract: Genomic imprinting results in parent-of-origin-dependent gene expression, but how three-dimensional genome organization contributes to imprinted gene regulation remains unclear. Using Capture Hi-C in mouse cortex and primary cortical neurons, we identified parental allele-specific chromatin architectures across multiple imprinted domains. These architectures largely originate from imprinting control regions and correlate with DNA methylation-sensitive CTCF binding. Active and inactive alleles of imprinted genes show distinct promoter interaction profiles and differential engagement with distal regulatory elements in both contact frequency and the epigenetic state of distal regions. A CRISPR interference screen identified a distal enhancer that regulates Mest-Copg2 imprinted expression through allele-specific chromatin interactions. In neurons, this enhancer activates Copg2 on the maternal allele, whereas on the paternal allele it drives Mest isoforms transcribed antisense to Copg2 and contributes to Copg2 repression. In summary, we show that allele-specific chromatin architecture coordinates maternal enhancer activity and paternal antisense transcription to control imprinted expression in neurons. 基因组印记导致基因表达具有亲本来源依赖性，但三维基因组组织如何参与印记基因调控仍不清楚。通过在小鼠皮层和原代皮层神经元中应用Capture Hi-C技术，我们鉴定了多个印记结构域中亲本等位基因特异性的染色质结构。这些结构主要起源于印记控制区，并与DNA甲基化敏感的CTCF结合相关。印记基因的活性等位基因与非活性等位基因在启动子相互作用谱上存在差异，并且在接触频率和远端区域的表观遗传状态方面，与远端调控元件的差异参与程度也不同。CRISPR干扰筛选鉴定出一个远端增强子，该增强子通过等位基因特异性的染色质相互作用调控Mest-Copg2印记表达。在神经元中，该增强子在母本等位基因上激活Copg2，而在父本等位基因上则驱动与Copg2反义转录的Mest异构体，并参与Copg2的抑制。总之，我们证明等位基因特异性的染色质结构协调母本增强子活性和父本反义转录，从而控制神经元中的印记表达。

documents.title: Preliminary analysis of chromatin accessibility in osteosarcoma tissues.
meta: Ye, Fan; Hu, Po
Clinics (Sao Paulo, Brazil)
documents.summary: 该研究通过ATAC-seq分析骨肉瘤染色质可及性，关注AP-1家族转录因子，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
documents.abstract: Osteosarcoma (OS) is highly invasive, metastatic, and lacks effective therapies, leading to poor prognosis. This study aims to dissect the core epigenetic features of OS from the perspective of chromatin accessibility to elucidate its pathogenesis and identify novel therapeutic targets. ATAC-seq was used to map the global chromatin accessibility profiles of OS tissues versus normal controls. We identified OS-specific aberrantly accessible chromatin regions and delineated enriched transcription factor binding motifs. Key transcription factors were validated by Western blotting and flow cytometry. Notably, in regions with enhanced accessibility, the binding probability of AP-1 family members (including Atf3, Fra1, Fra2, JunB, BATF, AP-1, Jun-AP1, Bach2, and CTCF) was significantly elevated. Further analysis indicates that JunB can inhibit apoptosis of OS cells and enhance their invasive ability, suggesting that it may be related to tumor progression. Overall, JunB, as a candidate molecule with potential research value, is worthy of further verification in subsequent in vivo models and clinical samples to determine its feasibility as an intervention target for OS. 骨肉瘤（Osteosarcoma, OS）具有高度侵袭性、转移性，且缺乏有效疗法，导致预后不良。本研究旨在从染色质可及性（chromatin accessibility）角度解析OS的核心表观遗传特征，以阐明其发病机制并发现新的治疗靶点。采用ATAC-seq技术绘制OS组织与正常对照的全局染色质可及性图谱。我们鉴定了OS特异性异常可及的染色质区域，并描绘了富集的转录因子结合基序。通过Western blotting和流式细胞术验证了关键转录因子。值得注意的是，在可及性增强的区域中，AP-1家族成员（包括Atf3、Fra1、Fra2、JunB、BATF、AP-1、Jun-AP1、Bach2和CTCF）的结合概率显著升高。进一步分析表明，JunB可抑制OS细胞凋亡并增强其侵袭能力，提示其可能与肿瘤进展相关。总体而言，JunB作为具有潜在研究价值的候选分子，值得在后续体内模型和临床样本中进一步验证，以确定其作为OS干预靶点的可行性。

documents.title: CTCF aligns single-cell TAD-like domain boundaries and stabilizes long-range active chromatin clusters.
meta: Chen, Ziyin; Li, Xuan; Dai, Yunpeng; Shao, Kaiwen; Sun, Haolun; Wu, Nan; Yan, Jian; Zhang, Yanxiao; Yu, Miao
Science advances
documents.summary: 该研究通过单细胞HiRES技术揭示CTCF缺失如何影响TAD边界稳定性和长距离活性染色质簇，与cpcdh基因家族在染色质结构调控中的潜在角色高度相关。
documents.abstract: CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF) is a key architectural protein in the three-dimensional (3D) genome, yet how its loss reshapes chromatin structure and transcription at single-cell resolution remains unclear. Using HiRES, which jointly profiles chromatin contacts and RNA from the same nucleus, we examined genome-wide effects of CTCF depletion. Topologically associating domain (TAD)-like domains (TLDs) across single cells remained largely unchanged in number and size after CTCF loss, but their boundaries became more variably positioned, and pseudobulk analyses revealed reduced interactions within A compartments. We also developed SALTAFinder to identify Spatially Aggregated Long-distance TLD Assemblies (SALTAs), clusters of TLDs occupying shared 3D space within single cells. A subset of SALTAs is enriched for highly expressed genes and super-enhancers and declines upon CTCF depletion. This structural reorganization coincided with a global reduction in per-cell RNA output, as indicated by HiRES and orthogonal measurements. Together, these findings suggest that CTCF contributes to the coordinated regulation of chromatin organization and transcriptional capacity and is associated with stabilization of long-range active chromatin clusters. CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）是三维（3D）基因组中的关键结构蛋白，但其缺失如何在单细胞分辨率下重塑染色质结构和转录仍不清楚。利用HiRES（HiRES）技术，该技术可同时从同一细胞核中分析染色质接触和RNA，我们研究了CTCF缺失的全基因组效应。在CTCF缺失后，单细胞中的拓扑关联结构域（TAD）样结构域（TLD）在数量和大小上基本保持不变，但其边界位置变得更加可变，且伪批量分析显示A区室内的相互作用减少。我们还开发了SALTAFinder（SALTAFinder）来识别空间聚集的长距离TLD组装体（SALTA），即单细胞中共享3D空间的TLD簇。部分SALTA富集了高表达基因和超级增强子，并在CTCF缺失后减少。这种结构重组与每个细胞RNA输出的整体下降同时发生，如HiRES和正交测量所示。综合来看，这些发现表明CTCF有助于染色质组织和转录能力的协调调控，并与长距离活性染色质簇的稳定化相关。
